description: This file declares functions for serializing and deserializing JSON data in a protected manner, involving TPM resource management. It includes functions to write a JSON value to a file with protection and to read a protected JSON value from a file.

methods.name: WriteProtectedJsonToFile
methods.description: Serializes a JSON value and writes it to a specified file with protection, utilizing TPM resources.

methods.name: ReadProtectedJsonFromFile
methods.description: Reads a protected JSON value from a specified file, utilizing TPM resources.
